'''Neil Goodacre''' is a Star Wars CCG player whose decks were published on [[Trandosite]], [[Rod Latham]]'s UK fan site.<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds122.htm Agents In The Desert], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001028162121/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds122.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
